Browser page load times out

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Always, timeout: 1 } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  try {
    await scrape(engine, url);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
